title: Excalibur | Boss Checklist Support
description: A retextured chronicle of your conquests!
body:
![Title](https://i.imgur.com/nAGG9kn.png)

This unofficial compatibility pack ensures that the textures in the [Boss Checklist](https://modrinth.com/mod/boss-checklist) Mod seamlessly integrate with the amazing [Excalibur](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/excal) resource pack.

**Features:**

*   Redesigned interface

For the best experience, use this pack alongside Excalibur.

**Credits:**

*   Maffhew – Creator of _Excalibur_
*   Yori3o – Creator of _Boss Checklist_

If this pack pleases thine eye, grant it a heart or spread word of it afar! 🏰

[Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/excalibur-boss-checklist-support)
